title: docs(ui-merge): fold objectui.org into objectstack docs, K1 — move the Object UI SDK guide (38 pages) and the 57 renderer-type pages into a new content/docs/sdk/ section
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). In the "Restore objectui.org docs deploy" project thread (card thread of #26993), on 2026-10-28:

- 03:24Z, on the decision card "objectui.org 文档站以后怎么处理?", Tesla chose 「B 并入 objectstack 文档站」. www.objectui.org stops being a separate site, and its docs fold into the objectstack docs site (`content/docs`, served at objectstack.ai/docs).
- 03:24Z, Tesla asked 「objectui 文档全部需要保留吗？这需要评估并和我沟通」. The card thread then sorted the 183 pages under `ui/content/docs` one by one into keep, merge, generate and delete, and put four questions to Tesla.
- 07:58Z, on that evaluation, Tesla answered 「VS Code 扩展 不会发布，其他同意」 and then 「你负责派卡执行」.

The fold is split into four cards. The first three can run in parallel; the fourth is blocked by them:
- **K1** moves the SDK pages.
- **K2** merges pages into existing ones.
- **K3** generates the component reference.
- **K4** retires the old site and adds the redirects.

This is card **K1**.

## 维护者速读

把 Object UI 作为独立 React SDK 的文档搬进 objectstack 文档站,新开 `content/docs/sdk/` 栏目,共 95 页:

- 原样保留的 38 页:SDK 入门、架构、渲染器、插件、CLI 和连 objectstack 后端的适配器。
- 57 个渲染器类型参考页:`dialog`、`select`、`data-table` 等。它们是在注册表里注册过、SDK 用户在 JSON 里会写到的类型,但不在 `sdui.manifest.json` 里。

在线演示组件(`InteractiveDemo` 等)改成静态 JSON 代码块。依据是你同意的第 3 条:第一轮不迁演示,不让主文档站多依赖 21 个 @object-ui 包。

本卡只新增页面,不删 `ui/content/docs` 里的原页,删除和跳转都由 K4 做。

## Wanted

1. A new top-level section `content/docs/sdk/` ("Object UI SDK"), listed in `content/docs/meta.json`. Its index says what the SDK is: render ObjectStack JSON schemas inside your own React app, MIT-licensed `@object-ui/*` packages. It also says how the SDK relates to the Console.
2. Move these 38 pages in (paths relative to `ui/content/docs/`), keeping their substance:
   - `index.md` (home)
   - `guide/`: `quick-start`, `building-crud-app`, `architecture-overview`, `schema-overview`, `schema-rendering`, `component-registry`, `fields`, `plugins`, `plugin-development`, `data-source`, `layout`, `theming`, `troubleshooting`
   - `core/schema-renderer`, `layout/app-shell`, `layout/sidebar-nav`, `api/schema-reference`
   - `utilities/`: `cli`, `create-plugin`, `data-objectstack`
   - `plugins/`: `index` plus `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-chatbot`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-editor`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-markdown`, `plugin-report`, `plugin-timeline`, `plugin-view`
3. Move in the 57 renderer-type pages, as a "Renderer reference" subsection. These are every `components/**` page except three groups:
   - the 17 that `sdui.manifest.json` covers, which are K3's: `basic/{icon,image,span,text}`, `complex/table`, `data-display/{alert,badge}`, `disclosure/accordion`, `form/{button,label}`, `layout/{box,card,container,flex,grid,stack,tabs}`;
   - `components/index`;
   - `toaster` and `semantic`, which have no registered type and are not moved.
   
   Each moved page keeps its type name as the slug, so K4 can map `/docs/components/<group>/<type>` one-to-one.
4. Rewrite every live-demo MDX component (`InteractiveDemo`, `DemoGrid`, `ComponentDemo`, `LiveSplitDemo`, `SchemaExample`, `SchemaThumbnail`, `ReactVsObjectUI`, `SchemaCatalogIndex`) as plain fenced `json` or `tsx` code blocks. `apps/docs` gains no `@object-ui/*` dependency. Measured on `main` 24351cfe: all 57 renderer pages, 14 of the 17 plugin pages and `core/schema-renderer` use one.
5. Fix links inside the moved pages so they point within objectstack docs. That covers links to other moved pages, to K2's merge targets and to K3's reference. Where a K2 or K3 target is not on `main` yet, link the section index; K4 sweeps the rest.
6. Record the old-path → new-path pairs in the PR body, as a table K4 copies into the redirect map.

⛔ Do not delete or edit pages under `ui/content/docs/` and do not touch `ui/apps/site`. K4 does both, together with the `ui/scripts` readers that pin those paths.

## Who acts

A `domain:devx` card thread. The surface is `content/docs/sdk/**` and `content/docs/meta.json`; `apps/docs` is touched only if an MDX component is genuinely needed, which item 4 is meant to avoid. The diff is mostly new pages and will pass the 3000-line human-merge threshold, so the maintainer merges it.

**Business reason.** Integrators of the published `@object-ui/*` packages (18.2.0) keep their SDK guide when www.objectui.org is folded away. The root README still sends them there (`npm install @object-ui/react @object-ui/components`).

## Acceptance

- The 95 pages render under `/docs/sdk/` in the `apps/docs` build. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs build` is green, the objectstack docs gates that the derived list names are green, and no `@object-ui/*` dependency is added to `apps/docs/package.json`.
- `git grep -n "InteractiveDemo\|ComponentDemo\|LiveSplitDemo\|SchemaExample" -- content/docs` prints nothing.
- The PR body carries the old → new path table, with 95 rows.

**Duplicate search.** objectstack-ai/objectstack, "objectui docs migrate into objectstack docs site content/docs sdk objectui.org redirect retire ui/apps/site": 33 hits, the first 10 read: #26993 (open, the deploy card this fold supersedes), #27030 (open, the Vercel maintainer card), #27048 (open, skills/objectui plugin-ai, different files), #26140, #26688, #24230, #25677, #26944, #25854, #26035 (closed or unrelated). No card moves the pages. **New.**

**Size:** L. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
